notes.title: Pre-Strike Journal Update
notes.content:
Hey there!

We've got a big journal update, along with some other things:

 An update to the journal! Learn more about the people you share your camp with.
 The journal also includes business earnings, so you can keep better track of your finances.
 Clicking on the mailbox now opens and closes it.
 A few other small bug fixes.

Thanks for sticking around, and don't forget to leave your suggestions and bugs in the Steam forum!

notes.title: Random Event Update!
notes.content:
Hey there!

It’s been a while since our last major update, but we’ve been working on some things! Today, we’re releasing an update for random events. More items should randomly pop up around the map and either supply you with some extra resources, or snatch them right out of your pocket!

Along with the truck carrying cargo, keep an eye out for:

A bottle washed ashore
Franny’s market
Theo’s axe
K-Rat’s concert

For 60 seconds, a dialogue box will pop up to let you know that a random event has spawned. Besides that, the item on the map will have a bubble with an exclamation point. If you’re still having difficulty finding the random events, let us know and we’ll try to make them more obvious in the future!

Due to popular demand, we’ve also added volume sliders for the side effects and music.

Thanks for sticking around, and we look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Steam Cloud Update
notes.content:
Hey there! We've added a few things to Pre-Strike!


The button to clear your save is disabled, but if you feel like you need to clear your save for whatever reason, we’ve made a forum post on how to do so through Steam.
A new random event will have a chance to appear every fifteen minutes or so – keep an eye on the dirt road!
Steam Cloud should make a backup of your save.
Your friends’ list will now be notified of your total level in Pre-Strike – the more you upgrade your businesses, the higher your total level will be.

Thanks for sticking around! If you find any bugs or have any suggestions, don't hesitate to let us know on the Steam discussion!

notes.title: Resources Update
notes.content:
Hi there!

We got notice that some of the members of the Camp weren't being entirely fair with their wages... We've had a word with them (yes, even Peanut), and you should now be getting enough resources for the work you're putting in! 

Here's what all we've done:

 You will now be paid much more per click from  The Dock, The Hunter, The Entertainment Area, and Peanut.  This only applies after you've unlocked + upgraded them. (Thank you KA_FLipZ!)
 Small fixes to UI.
 Lag from clicking the mailbox should now be gone.
 Typos in the achievements have been fixed.

If you come across any bugs, or have any suggestions, don't hesitate to post about them in the Steam discussion!

notes.title: Achievement Update
notes.content:
A small update regarding achievements:


The ‘Live, Laugh, Love' achievement now unlocks at getting The House to level 85, instead of 100.
All achievements now show up in the achievement screen in-game.


Let us know if you come across any bugs, or have any suggestions for future updates.

Thanks!

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Hi!

Thanks for all the feedback on the initial release of Pre-Strike! We’ve had a lot of good tips and advice, and have tried to implement some of that into our first official update. 


 Got rid of the anti-cheat.
 Improved legibility of UI.
 Added 1600x900 resolution (thanks spoilerspree!). 
 Avast should no longer give a false positive. 
 Added a new letter to the mailbox. 
 Fixed an issue where crashing may cause a huge amount of offline progress.
 Changed Steam store page tags to be more relevant to the game.
 Pre-Strike should now let your friend's list know that you're in the camp.


We have a few other things in the works, such as more journal pages and other art-related things. We are also brainstorming ways to make the game more engaging. 

If you come across any bugs, or have any suggestions, definitely let us know in the Steam forum. Thanks for reading!
